openai.source: OpenAI API pricing page, Standard tier, text tokens (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing; redirected from https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing), retrieved 2026-11-20. The page lists base model names (gpt-4o, gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-mini), not snapshot names; the pinned snapshots are assumed to bill at the base-model price. The page shows no revision date.
openai.assumption: Standard (non-Batch, non-Flex, non-Priority) list prices; any account credits or discounts are ignored.

azure.source: Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices), productName contains 'OpenAI', armRegionName 'eastus2', Global deployment meters, retrieved 2026-11-20. Used only for the superseded provisional Azure responses (protocol addendum A3).
